Returns the address mode of the depth texture coordinate (w) that the sampler has, as it was set with [SamplerAddressModeW](SamplerAddressModeW) (or the default of [CreateSampler](CreateSampler)). This is a BlitzLLVM extension. The value is the one that the sampler keeps, which is the one that was given after it was kept inside what is accepted: 0 repeat, 1 mirror, 2 clamp or 3 border.
@param sampler  The sampler to ask.
@returns The setting: 0 repeat, 1 mirror, 2 clamp or 3 border.
